//: TempestOS sample operator configuration (WP 17.2A, ADR-0146). Copy this file
// 1: to 'appsettings.json' next to the running executable (or in the current
// 2: directory) and edit the values you need; every key here can also be set
// 3: with a TEMPEST_-prefixed environment variable ('__' as the section
// 6: to highest: this file next to the executable, this file in the current
// 7: directory, environment variables, the command line. Remove every '//'
// 8: comment key below before using this as a real appsettings.json - JSON has
// 9: no native comment syntax, and these keys are illustrative only.

Persistence.//RootPath: Where the persistence database (and logs/, see Runtime:Logging below) is written. Defaults to a working-directory-relative folder (SqlitePersistenceStore.DefaultRootPath) when unset.
Persistence.//Backend: 'sqlite' - the default, and the only recognised value. The file-per-key backend this key once could also select ('files') is deleted (v0.18.0, ADR-0144); any other value is a fatal configuration error.

Logging.//MinimumLevel: One of Trace, Debug, Information, Warning, Error, Critical, None. Defaults to Information.

Plugins.//RootDirectory: Where the Host's Plugin Discovery phase looks for manifests. Defaults to a 'Plugins' folder next to the executable.
Plugins.//ManifestFileName: The manifest file name Plugin Discovery looks for inside each plugin's own folder. Defaults to the platform's own convention.
Plugins.//Disabled: A comma-separated list of plugin ids Plugin Discovery records as disabled without removing their files.

Projects.//FolderRoot: Where each project's own Windows Explorer folder is generated (PO decision 2026-10-01): <root>/<customer>/<project>/<standard subfolders>, finding existing customer and project folders before creating any. Defaults to 'D:\01 Projects' on Windows and to nothing elsewhere; set it to an empty string or 'off' to switch folder generation off.
Projects.//StandardSubfolders: The subfolders created inside every project folder - a JSON array (or one ';'-separated string). TBC by the Product Owner: a v1.0.0 BLOCKER (docs/releases/v1.0.0/WorkPackages.md). Empty by default.
Projects.//QuoteSubfolder: The subfolder (inside the project folder) the quote PDF export starts in. Unset or empty means the project folder itself.

Identity.//DisplayName: Overrides the session principal's display name (otherwise the OS account name). Never changes the underlying identity id, which is always read from the OS.
Identity.//Role: Engineer (the default) or Checker - governs which commands the session is offered. Never changes the identity id.
